name: Perplexity
shortDescription: AI search that answers questions with linked sources.
longDescription: Perplexity answers questions from the web and shows linked sources. A consumer Free versus Pro split was not confirmed from the docs we could read.
pricingNotes: Use docs.perplexity.ai pricing guide; confirm Free tier in browser.
bestFor: Web research, once you confirm the current plan in a browser
notIdealFor: Anyone treating this card as a finished verification
A self-hosted crawler or vector database
strength: The docs describe a web-research product, with API pricing written up on the official docs site.
weakness: The API pricing page we could read did not state a free-tier amount or a monthly starting price.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
